boardRow.name: The Relay Valley
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Set the ridge chain, chart the quiet pockets, and defend a drone walking the patrol you recorded.

goals: Link the four ridge relays by line of sight.
Record one patrol and hand it to a drone.
Defend the drone while it walks your route.
rules: Relays connect only when they can see one another.
Drones drop in dead zones, where data-rustlers ambush.
Corrupted-playbook waves replay your recording glitched.
briefing.geographyLine: Two exposed relay ridges stand at height five above a thick valley floor, split by a dead gap and line-of-sight fog pockets.

contracts.name: Echo Canyon
contracts.description: Engine dependency: broadcast-mirror playbook consumer not yet implemented. Teaching intent: vary your own patterns because every recorded habit returns as a corrupted copy on the next wave.

objectiveMetadata.description: Use a playbook, then counter the corrupted copy fielded on the next wave.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Vary your own patterns; your habits have a shadow.

broadcastMirrorZones.description: Everything recorded in this field is mirrored as a corrupted enemy playbook on the next wave.

broadcastMirror.description: Each playbook used this run returns as a corrupted enemy copy on the next wave.

boardRow.name: Echo Canyon
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Every lesson carries across the canyon and comes marching back one wave later.

goals: Use a playbook, then survive its corrupted copy on the next wave.
Break your recorded pattern before the copies learn the canyon.
rules: Every playbook used this run is broadcast-mirrored to the enemy next wave.
Repeated habits escalate the self-play pressure.
Different patterns deny the copies a complete answer.
briefing.geographyLine: A long canyon floor between two high echo shelves, with enemy lanes entering from both ends.

contracts.name: The Dead Band
contracts.description: Relay Valley terrain variant. Engine dependency: contract-level signal-suppression consumer not yet implemented. Teaching intent: feel what agents contribute by losing drones, playbooks, and relay chains for one run.

objectiveMetadata.description: Secure the valley using hands, boots, and the four oldest tools without signal systems.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Nostalgia by subtraction: missing the drones is the lesson.

signalNullZones.description: Signal does not propagate anywhere inside the iron-ore shadow.

signalSuppression.description: No drones, no playbooks, and no relay chains operate in the Dead Band.

boardRow.name: The Dead Band
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Signal dies in the iron valley; carry the oldest tools in by hand and walk them home.

goals: Secure the valley with hands, boots, and the four oldest tools.
Hold without drones, playbooks, or relay chains.
rules: The iron body blocks signal across the whole valley.
Drones, playbooks, and relay chains do not operate here.
The far end contains no hidden reward.
briefing.geographyLine: The Relay Valley ground under one complete iron-ore signal shadow, with genuinely nothing buried at its far end.

contracts.name: Relay Rush
contracts.description: Relay Valley terrain variant. Engine dependency: event-driven interference-front cycle and signal-muting consumer not yet implemented. Teaching intent: expand under deadline and triage at speed.

objectiveMetadata.description: Light N relays before the interference front arrives.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Expansion under deadline; triage at speed.

interferenceFrontZones.description: A wall of static crosses this corridor on a schedule and mutes everything it swallows.

interferenceFront.description: An event-driven wall of static crosses the map on a schedule and mutes everything it swallows.

boardRow.name: Relay Rush
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Light the ridge chain before a wall of un-inked static crosses the valley.

goals: Light N relays before the interference front arrives.
Choose which links to save when the front overtakes the valley.
rules: The interference front crosses the map on a schedule.
Everything swallowed by the front is muted.
The front appears as creeping desaturation, like un-inked paper spreading.
briefing.geographyLine: The Relay Valley ridge chain inside one map-wide corridor for the scheduled interference front.
